# Purpose

This document describes `analysis.R`, a small script that summarizes synthetic numeric marks using base R.

## Requirements

R version 4.0 or later is recommended. No additional packages are required for the calculations.

## Inputs

The script uses four synthetic numeric values: 75, 82, 68, and 91. These are demonstration values, not real student records.

## R Script

```{r}
marks <- c(75, 82, 68, 91)

average_mark <- mean(marks)
median_mark <- median(marks)
number_of_records <- length(marks)

average_mark
median_mark
number_of_records
```

## Outputs

The code chunk returns the average, median, and number of observations. Knit this document to generate the output.

## Verification

Check that the input contains four values. Independently calculate the mean and median, then compare the results with R's output. Preview or knit this `.Rmd` file and confirm that the headings and code chunk render correctly.
